title: Plate with a circular hole in tension, 2D plane stress (Kirsch)
source: Kirsch, Zeitschrift des VDI 42 (1898) 797–807; Timoshenko and Goodier, Theory of Elasticity, 3rd ed., 1970, §35

quantities.quantity: σ_xx at the top of the hole (0, 1) over the remote stress
quantities.reason: the reference is the infinite plate; the finite plate (W = 60a, loaded ends 30a away) raises the peak by a few tenths of a percent, and the stress extrapolated to the hole surface adds up to about 1%

quantities.quantity: σ_yy at the side of the hole (1, 0) over the remote stress
quantities.reason: infinite-plate value −S; finite width and extrapolation as for Kt, on a smaller value
